Diabetes and prediabetes can develop gradually, often without obvious symptoms. However, your body may show early warning signs that indicate rising blood sugar levels or insulin resistance. Recognising these signs and getting timely blood tests can help prevent complications.
In this video, Hansaji explains seven early signs of diabetes that you should never ignore and shares practical dietary and yoga-based approaches to support healthy blood sugar levels.
7 early signs of diabetes covered in this video:
1. Frequent urination, especially during the night.
